purpose: Independent verification of every development scorecard and full deployment recipe replay for the fixed shortlist

round2.phase_pooling: Independently recompute paired-seed-then-native-phase and per-seed means from every stored native phase probability array

comparison: Predictions bitwise equal; scalar metrics absolute tolerance 1e-12 with zero relative tolerance; reference counts exact

public: No public reference read or score by the independent development verifier; final public result uses its distinct one-time gate
source: Complete both round implementations and tests before first audit; record verifier source SHA in each receipt and preserve source thereafter
